title: Trustee Scholarship
text: The Trustee Scholarship covers full tuition at USC and is awarded to 100 students. Candidates are chosen by USC faculty and staff from all students who apply by the December 1 deadline. Candidates’ curriculum, achievements, talent, involvement and leadership are all considered. Students selected as finalists are contacted in February and must complete an interview. Information from the financial aid office can be found at usc.edu/admission/fa and more information about the program itself can be found at usc.edu
